verdict.rationale: Bento documents a first-party hosted MCP server at mcp.bentonow.com that lets an AI assistant look up subscribers, create broadcasts, and track events "all through natural conversation." Bento Skills adds agent guidance and safety rules for live account operations, and the homepage advertises an in-product AI that builds from a plain-text description. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works in practice, and documented detail on what the in-app plain-text AI builder covers and which account operations the MCP exposes beyond the listed examples.
